author: Vebe Nyc
text: NM Septic was able to repair a crushed pipe and rescue us from the potential huge expense of a new system. During the process they patiently explained the details of a full replacement and we were aware of our options from the beginning. There is no question that we would go forward with the company either to repair or replace. Very grateful for being treated like family.

author: Martin J Coffey
text: Great company!  Now that we have found New Milford Septic Services, we plan on keeping them.  They are superior to any company we have ever used previously! We received first rate customer service from beginning to end.  They were prompt and professional.

author: Ahsia Badi
text: This team was professional, considerate, timely and super responsive. We had them come out a couple of times over the past years and trust their opinion. Their pricing is reasonable and they not only emptied our septic but built out a new pipe system from the house to the septic for us.

author: John McGraw
text:
New Milford Septic has been my go to company for years and anytime I had a problem they responded in a timely fashion.
I also needed some repair work that was done at a reasonable rate.
I have recommended this company to others and will continue to do so.

author: Amy G
text: Gabby at the office is beyond amazing. She called me right back when my usual company didn’t even return my calls! Had an emergency situation. She got me in the next day. Shane and Jaden came out and fixed me up in no time! They were very helpful and taught me some things as a homeowner I had no clue! Highly recommend!!!!!
